threshold_rule: Maximum specificity among development out-of-fold thresholds with sensitivity >= 0.95; ties prefer the highest threshold.
threshold_target_rationale: Illustrate prioritizing fewer missed malignant samples while retaining specificity. This is an analysis assumption, not a clinical standard.
feature_selection: none; all 30 measurements, excluding identifier and diagnosis
calibration: Sigmoid calibration for SVM wraps the complete scaler-model pipeline inside each calibration fold. Logistic regression and random forest probabilities are assessed without added calibration.
final_evaluation: Freeze the selected pipeline and development-selected threshold before evaluating the holdout. Reuse cached final results on rerun; reject an incompatible freeze.
uncertainty: 95% Wilson intervals for holdout sensitivity and specificity; fold standard deviation is descriptive, not a confidence interval.
scope: Classification of sampled breast masses in the UCI WDBC benchmark; no inference about future risk, population screening, or clinical readiness.
